# Validate and route lead enquiries for human review

## Who this is for
Small-business owners, operations teams, consultants, and n8n beginners who want to validate enquiry data before connecting a form, CRM, spreadsheet, or help desk.

## What it does
The workflow creates two fictional enquiries, normalizes the email and text fields, identifies missing information, and routes each record to either a clarification queue or a human-approved pilot state. It never contacts a customer or changes an external system.

## How to set it up
Run the sample as provided first. Confirm that `sample-complete-001` reaches `ready_for_human_approved_pilot` and `sample-needs-details-002` reaches `needs_clarification`. No credentials or accounts are required.

## Requirements
n8n with the built-in Manual Trigger, Code, If, and Edit Fields nodes. All included people and records are fictional.

## How to customize
Replace only the `Create safe sample enquiries` node after mapping your incoming field names. Keep validation and a named human owner. Add CRM updates or messages only after testing non-sensitive samples and documenting a pause or rollback path. A valid record is not permission to contact someone; retain human approval before any customer-facing action.
